001-root-array.json.note: The root must be an object, not an array.

002-root-null.json.note: The root must be an object, not null.

003-root-string.json.note: The root must be an object, not a string.

010-missing-structures.json.note: structures is required, even when empty.

011-missing-decorations.json.note: decorations is required, even when empty.

012-missing-milestones.json.note: milestones is required, even when empty.

014-missing-founders-stone.json.note: founders_stone is required even though it may be null.

018-seed-negative.json.note: seed is an unsigned integer, so a negative value is rejected.

021-tier-town.json.note: tier must be camp, hamlet or village.

022-resources-negative-planks.json.note: A resource balance may not be negative.

024-resources-extra-field.json.note: The resources object is closed, so a gold balance is rejected.

025-earned-negative-seeds.json.note: Lifetime earned may not be negative.

029-structure-unknown-id.json.note: A structure id must be one of the legal ids.

030-structure-extra-field.json.note: The structure object is closed, so a display name is rejected.

031-status-unknown.json.note: status must be planned, waiting, building or complete.

035-complete-without-completed-day.json.note: A complete structure needs its completed_day.

036-complete-stage-two.json.note: A complete structure must be at stage 3.

037-complete-progress-below-one.json.note: A complete structure must have progress 1.

038-complete-bad-completed-day.json.note: completed_day must be a valid day.

039-planned-with-completed-day.json.note: completed_day is present only on a complete structure.

040-building-stage-three.json.note: A building structure may not be at stage 3, which is reserved for complete.

041-building-progress-one.json.note: A building structure may not have progress 1, which is reserved for complete.

043-waiting-for-on-building.json.note: waiting_for is present only while the status is waiting.

044-waiting-active-days-zero.json.note: waiting_for.active_days must be at least 1, so 0 is rejected.

045-waiting-active-days-over-max.json.note: waiting_for.active_days may not exceed 3650, so 3651 is rejected.

046-waiting-active-days-fractional.json.note: waiting_for.active_days is an integer, so 1.5 is rejected.

048-waiting-for-quick-answers-only.json.note: waiting_for must be exactly { active_days }, so { quick_answers: 5 } fails both the missing active_days and the closed-object rule at the same pointer.

049-waiting-for-active-days-and-quick-an.note: waiting_for carrying the removed quick_answers key next to a valid active_days breaks only the closed-object rule.

050-waiting-for-extra-field.json.note: waiting_for is closed, so an extra hours field is rejected alongside a valid active_days.

053-crossing-variant-on-workshop-1.json.note: workshop_1 takes a tool variant, so footbridge is not allowed there.

054-guest-house-on-workshop-1.json.note: guest_house is only allowed on workshop_2.

055-guest-house-on-crossing.json.note: crossing takes footbridge or jetty, not guest_house.

056-footbridge-on-workshop-2.json.note: workshop_2 takes a tool or guest_house, not footbridge.

057-variant-not-in-enum.json.note: A variant must be one of the known variant values.

058-duplicate-structure-id.json.note: Structure ids are unique across the structures array.

061-decoration-slot-256.json.note: A decoration slot may not exceed 255.

062-decoration-slot-negative.json.note: A decoration slot may not be negative.

063-decorations-sixty-five.json.note: At most 64 decorations, so 65 is rejected.

064-decoration-extra-field.json.note: The decoration object is closed, so a display name is rejected.

065-decoration-missing-shown.json.note: A decoration needs its shown flag.

067-milestone-duplicate.json.note: Each milestone id appears at most once.

068-milestone-unknown-id.json.note: A milestone id must be one of the seven.

069-milestone-day-unpadded.json.note: A milestone day must be YYYY-MM-DD.

071-tools-seen-duplicate.json.note: tools_seen lists each tool at most once.

072-tools-seen-unknown-tool.json.note: tools_seen items must be known tools.

074-stats-negative-turns.json.note: A lifetime count may not be negative.

075-stats-count-over-max.json.note: A lifetime count may not exceed 1000000000.

076-stats-extra-field.json.note: The stats object is closed, so a level field is rejected.

077-stats-lifetime-quick-answers-present.note: lifetime_quick_answers was removed by SPEC Revision 1, so the closed stats object rejects it.

078-founders-stone-days-zero.json.note: A founders stone needs at least one day.

079-founders-stone-days-32.json.note: A founders stone may cover at most 31 days.

081-founders-stone-turns-fractional.json.note: A founders stone count is a whole number.
